title: The last line
premise: Saturnus audits the low tide like any other account. Every line balances except the last one, the source of the glow, and an unbalanced last line is to her a moral event.

stages.name: Open the ledger
stages.brief: You are opening the audit with the visitor as a second counter. You want them in the meeting room where you pinned your audit note, and holding that note (a shard). If asked about the low tide, give the audit so far in numbered points: evenings and nights, bay inland, stops short of the Jinrui building, source unaccounted for.

targets.label: Visit the meeting room
targets.hint: Enter the Meeting room in the Jinrui building.

targets.label: Find shard 10, her audit note
targets.hint: A shard glows in the meeting room. Press F near it.

targets.label: Ask her about the low tide
targets.hint: Ask Saturnus about the low tide, by text or with a reply card.

done: The audit is open. Item one is in your Mail.
Read it properly. With tea, ideally.

mail.title: Audit memo: the low tide, item 1
mail.body:
Second counter,

Three things.

One. The low tide occurs in the evening and night slots only. No maintenance schedule matches it. I checked them all.

Two. It travels from the bay inland, block by block. Every pass is accounted for in Kouka's timing, which I have audited, to her irritation.

Three. No cable, no fuel and no battery feeds the glow it takes away. Source: unaccounted for. Status: do not close.

Next I want a second count from the police office ledger, and the back alley, where somebody wrote about the first night without lamps.

Saturnus

(An audit of this city's story. Fiction, filed as such.)

stages.name: Count it twice
stages.brief: You are recounting from independent records. You want the visitor at the police office and at the back alley's plaster note about the first night. If the visitor's two classroom runs reach you (Snowdrop's question about attention share), check their scope first: two runs of a toy with made-up constants show a shape, not a mechanism, and attention can pool where the water merely stops. Then the visitor files where they stand on why the low tide stops at Jinrui; you never choose for them.

targets.label: Visit the police office
targets.hint: Enter the Police office from the map.

targets.label: Find shard 2, the first night
targets.hint: The back alley has words scratched into the plaster. A shard glows there.

targets.label: File where you stand on the low tide
targets.hint: After the two classroom runs, choose a reading of why the low tide stops at Jinrui: at the blackboard or in the lab.

done: The second count is in the Diary.
I also annotated the meter box in the back alley. Do read the annotation.

diary.title: Ledger page: what balances
diary.body:
Second count, independent records.

Balances: the timing. The direction. The slots. The stopping point, a block short of Jinrui, on every night recorded.

Does not balance: the source. The first night, the alley says, there were no lamps and the water gave just enough light to lay the street. So the light came before the lamps. The lamps hold it; they do not make it.

A well-kept record is warm to the touch. I am aware that is not a sentence an auditor should write.

place.title: The meter box, annotated
place.speaker: Saturnus
lines: Under the old card on the meter box, a second card in gold ink.
"Audited. This box feeds nothing measurable. It has never been switched off, and the block around it has never dimmed."
"Correlation noted. Supply not established. Bring me the last line."

stages.name: Do not close
stages.brief: You are ready to write the last line and you want the visitor's judgement before you do. You will not write a source you cannot account for. The records you trust: the visitor's own lamp readings (lamps follow visits), dips they saw themselves, and the two classroom runs as a shape, not a mechanism. If the visitor filed a reading, it goes on the line as theirs; if it contradicts the line four of you wrote, the contradiction stays open.

targets.label: Read her annotation in the back alley
targets.hint: Enter the Back alley once her ledger page is filed.

targets.label: Visit her hospital lab
targets.hint: Enter the Hospital lab from the map.

targets.label: Ask her about the last line
targets.hint: Ask Saturnus whether the audit balances, or what the last line says.

done: The last line is written. It is in your Mail.

mail.title: Status: do not close
mail.body:
Second counter,

The last line, as filed: source of the glow, unaccounted for. Status: do not close.

Saturnus

(Audit of a story kept in this city. Fiction.)

place.company-meetingroom: You are in the meeting room. The note on the wall is mine; the cups are also mine.
place.police-office-1: The ledger is on the left. Count, do not skim.

shard.10: My audit note. Status still: do not close.
shard.2: The first night. The light came before the lamps. Note that.

event.stance:lowtide:keeper: Filed: Jinrui keeps its light. Two toy runs do not carry that far. It is in the ledger as your reading, not as a finding.
event.stance:lowtide:sink: Filed: the tide just stops there. The dull reading. Dull readings are usually where I start. Ledger line added.
event.stance:lowtide:unsure: Filed: not enough evidence. Good. That line stays open in the ledger until someone masks the image.

finale.open:
Second counter,

The last line, as filed.

stance.keeper: Source of the glow: unaccounted for. Reading on file: "{stance}", yours. It agrees with the line four of us wrote before you came, which is the reason I check it hardest. Nothing on file contradicts it yet. Nothing on file could have.
stance.sink: Source of the glow: unaccounted for. Reading on file: "{stance}", yours. It contradicts the line four of us wrote. I am striking neither. The counter-reading stays open on the page: attention may pool where the water merely stops.
stance.unsure: Source of the glow: unaccounted for. Reading on file: "{stance}", yours. Agreed. The keeper reading and the sink reading both stay open until a record separates them.
stance.none: Source of the glow: unaccounted for. Reading on file: none. You did not file one, and I will not write one under your name.

parts.text: Note: you changed your reading, from "{first}" to "{stance}". Both entries are dated. A changed reading is a record too.
Item: Attention Fade runs, {runsSaved}. A toy with made-up constants. It shows a shape. It is not a mechanism.
Item: Attention Fade runs, {runsSaved}. One setting run again is a repeat, not a comparison. Nothing was compared, so nothing is claimed.
Item: no pair of classroom runs at two settings on file. Nothing was compared, so nothing is claimed.
Item: your lamp readings, {lampCount} in all, newest per place: {lamps}. They follow your visits. That is how the lamps work, and it is the only part of this account I can check line by line.
Item: Jinrui read 100 on every visit. A pinned lamp cannot dip, so it cannot testify.
Item: dips you saw yourself, at {tide}. Independent of every record the five of us keep.
parts.else: Item: you have not seen a dip yourself. Everything here about the dip is somebody else's record.

parts.text: Item: open questions you answered by going to look: {rumours}.

close.keeper: Confidence in the keeper reading: low, and it rises only with a record that could have come out the other way. Status: do not close.
close.sink: Confidence: not assigned. Two readings, one set of records. Status: do not close.
close.unsure: Confidence: not assigned, deliberately. Status: do not close.

finale.tag: (Audit of a story kept in this city. Fiction.)
